Welcome to Broughton Transport Solutions
BIG ENOUGH TO COPE, SMALL ENOUGH TO CARE
We are a family run logistics company in Wiltshire which has established an enviable reputation both locally and internationally for the quality of our haulage transport and pallet transport services.
Specialising in UK and International transport using temperature controlled transport and ambient transport, with our modern fleet of vehicles we offer chilled, frozen and ambient deliveries across the UK and Europe.
Operating out of modern premises in Wiltshire we have a full understanding of the level of logistical services and groupage shipping required by both large and smaller customers.
We guarantee to always deliver to a high standard.
Our transport fleet covers approximately 4,000,000 kms / 2,500,000 miles per year. On average we do approximately 3000 channel crossings across the English channel per year using both the Channel tunnel and cross channel ferries. Our vehicles are renewed every five years to ensure reliability for our customers.
Our fleet of refrigerated vehicles offer temperature control led deliveries in the U.K. and Europe. All of our vehicles are equipped with tracking devices to ensure the safety of our customer products. We can pinpoint the vehicle at any stage of the delivery and give real time eta's to our customers.
Our state of the art trailers can accommodate frozen and / or chilled deliveries within the same trailer. Using divided compartments the product can be separated to ensure the different products are kept at the right temperature. Our trailers are serviced and calibrated regularly to ensure the environment for the product is perfect for transportation every time.
Due to our continued support to the environment, Broughton Transport have "state of the art vehicle tracking" and "optimisation" for our deliveries to ensure we are reducing the carbon footprint.
WAREHOUSING & STORAGE
Using our state of the art refrigerated lorries we offer fast and efficient temperature controlled logistics from ambient to frozen deliveries across UK and Europe.

Broughton Transport Solutions Ltd offers a wide range of UK transport, European transport and International transport services covering all areas of general haulage across UK, Europe and R.O.W. including groupage shipping. If you are looking for shipping, either within the UK or for international transport of goods then get in touch for a quote.
Our core business
Our core business is refrigerated transport for several different markets and companies in the UK and Europe. We deliver perishable goods, dairy products, pharmaceutical products, medical supplies and FMCG for UK and global transport as well as fresh fruit and vegetables, food packaging and food related products every day from Holland and Belgium into the U.K. When delivering to the UK we work with our customers to manage the delivery cycle to make sure we export out of the UK back to Holland and Belgium to reduce our carbon footprint and to make this cost effective for our customers.
What we offer
Through utilising our vehicles placed strategically all over Europe we can offer our customers a service second to none, whether it be a full load of meat to be loaded and delivered to Rungis market on a same day basis or a helicopter blade to be delivered to Naples we can offer express delivery.
If your consignment is smaller we can also offer express delivery throughout Europe using vans.
Our transport fleet consists of the following:-
18 tonne Curtainside Rigids
26 Tonne Curtainside Rigids
Should you require we can also offer a tail-lift service.
Using our vehicles we can also offer other bespoke transport services, in the past we have carried out house removals to Europe offering customers almost a DIY service, we arrive and assist in loading the trailer then transport your goods to your chosen destination.
Through various ferry contacts we are able to send our vehicles to far flung destinations transporting your goods to places such as:-
Greek Islands - Corfu, Santorini
Canary Islands - Tenerife, Gran Canaria, Lanzarote, Fuertaventura
Balearic Islands - Ibiza, Mallorca
If your chosen destination is not mentioned please get in touch and i am sure we will be able to assist
Delivering you piece of mind with...
Expertise - With over 40 years of experience of temperature controlled distribution, delivering time sensitive and perishable products for our customers, we work closely with our clients to make sure we understand their requirements, what is required by us as a transport company and make sure we deliver, every time, our customer expectations.
Great communication - We regularly communicate with our customers to ascertain what their future projections, constraints, hurdles, aspirations are, in order for us to manage their future deliveries. We will always do "our best" to make sure every customer is happy with everything we do for them.
A total logistical solution - We offer a full package to our customers, whether your delivery is a full load or just one pallet we can accommodate your requirements. For more logistics information fill in the form below and we will contact you back as soon as possible.
As a reliable transport company in Wiltshire, we provide groupage shipping. We work with our proven and established key partners in freight and shipping to make sure that your goods are shipped in a timely and efficient manner. We track shipping using GPS and our proven processes so that you are updated on the latest stage of goods shipping.
Groupage shipping involves combining cargo from a number of shippers into a single shipment, usually in a single shipping container. This allows us to keep costs down and to track your goods better. To find out more, get in touch.
From our headquarters in Wiltshire, we provide general haulage shipping throughout the UK - whether that’s to or from Devon and Cornwall in the south-west UK or to Wales, Manchester, Edinburgh and Aberdeen, in the north of Scotland.
International and European Transport
We also provide international transport around the world. Broughton Transport ships goods for many of our customers across Europe including from the UK, as well as between European countries.
European transport is provided using our up to date, modern lorries, and one of our specialities is transporting fresh produce and other consumable products, thanks to our refrigeration and freezer compartments which can be controlled at the exact temperature that your goods need to be at. This means that any products we ship for you will remain fresh, and of the highest quality during the shipment - even during long journeys across European borders.
Thanks to our temperature-controlled lorries, we provide the highest standard of quality shipping throughout European countries including France, Spain, Germany and Italy.
We have many years logistics experience in UK transport, European transport and international transport backed up by our fantastic customer testimonials. Our professional general haulage drivers and key partners also have the experience to understand how to make sure that your goods are shipped and the service levels are at the high level that you expect from us.
Logistics services we provide include:
Next day pallet delivery
Warehousing and storage
Global transport services with friendly local support
We are a friendly transport company in Wiltshire, UK. It doesn’t matter where you want to ship your goods from or where they are going, we are always available locally to help you. If you have any questions or you would like a quote for general haulage, then get in touch today. We are always happy to help.
